backend/main.mo: Defines storage mixin usage and data types for render rules and Genesis Craft previews.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence reports detailing Pinata upload fixes and metadata path updates.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of major frontend files for build reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base setup defining theme variables, dark mode values, and global styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component defining views, project types, settings defaults, and persistence integration.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDestructi: Reusable destructive-action confirmation dialog wired to a global confirm store.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Create: Dialog for creating a new project by entering name, symbol, size, and pixel‑art mode.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/NewPro: Tile button that opens the flow to create a new project.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Projec: Dialog allowing users to edit a project’s name, symbol, size, and pixel‑art mode.
Dashboard tile displaying project info with actions to open, edit settings, or delete.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer with attribution and heart icon styling.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive navigation header with project info, save status, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/HoverTooltip.tsx: Hover/focus tooltip component with animated popover styling.
frontend/src/components/icons/index.tsx: Exports lightweight inline SVG React components replacing lucide-react icons.
frontend/src/components/MotionIconButton: Animated icon button component with scaling and focus ring behavior.
frontend/src/components/PinataKeyGuideDi: Dialog explaining how to obtain the correct Pinata JWT token, with warnings and step‑by‑step instructions.
frontend/src/components/SaveStatusIndica: Tiny status label that shows saving progress or success based on a status prop.
frontend/src/components/VaultPublishingC: Controls for locking, unlocking, and uploading a generated NFT collection to IPFS using Pinata.
frontend/src/components/VaultViewModeTog: Two‑button toggle that switches between compact and grid view modes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useConfirmDestructive: Provides a Zustand-powered confirm dialog store and a promise-based destructive confirmation hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity auth provider and hook managing login, stored identities, and auth client lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/usePinataKeyValidatio: Debounced hook that validates a Pinata JWT and reports status and messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file noting no backend queries are required.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup with theme variables, base resets, motion settings, and custom utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app, wrapping it with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/pages/Builder.tsx: NFT builder UI for composing previews, uploading traits, and managing generated tokens with canvas rendering.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard page that lists projects, handles creating, opening, updating, and deleting projects, and manages dialogs for project creation and settings.
frontend/src/pages/Preview.tsx: Preview page that composes selected trait images on a canvas, supports random shuffling with rule validation, and updates preview settings like pixel mode.
frontend/src/pages/RarityWorkshop.tsx: Rarity Workshop for editing trait weights per layer, auto-normalizing values, and providing tools for adjusting rarity including locking and proportional changes.
frontend/src/pages/Rules.tsx: Rules editor allowing creation, editing, duplication, and deletion of trait compatibility rules, with validation of primary and incompatible traits.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Project settings page for editing metadata, blockchain selection, Pinata API keys, and managing Solana creators with validation and live updates.
frontend/src/pages/Vault.tsx: React page managing NFT vault generation, filtering, sorting, worker messaging, and ZIP export, including a custom SimpleZipCreator.
frontend/src/pages/Workshop.tsx: UI for editing project layers and traits with add, delete, rename, reorder, and rule‑cleanup logic.
frontend/src/utils/ipfsPublishing.ts: Handles uploading generated NFT images and metadata to Pinata with progress tracking and CID management.
frontend/src/utils/metadataPresets.ts: Generates metadata objects for previews and export across chains, resolving templates and IPFS paths.
frontend/src/utils/persistence.ts: Provides atomic localStorage save/load, legacy cleanup, storage‑size checks, and simple quota detection.
frontend/src/utils/pinata.ts: Utility for validating Pinata JWTs and uploading files, JSON, and directories to IPFS via Pinata’s API.
frontend/src/utils/vaultGeneratorProtoco: Defines TypeScript interfaces and type guards for all UI–worker message types used in NFT generation.
frontend/src/utils/yieldToUI.ts: Provides a helper that yields to the browser event loop to keep the UI responsive during long tasks.
frontend/src/workers/vaultGenerator.work: Implements the NFT generation worker handling trait selection, rule validation, DNA creation, and optional OffscreenCanvas image compositing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme settings, colors, spacing, breakpoints, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes current project configuration, features, issues, and requirements for fixing Pinata directory upload behavior.
